intro: Gentlemen, Gameweek 6. Liverpool lost 0-3 to Man City, Chelsea beat Bournemouth 5-1, and Coventry beat Newcastle 4-1. Brahmes scored 55 and was the top score of the week. Jack scored 29 and was the bottom. Ben's 49 took him to first, a single place up. Asher's 39 dropped him to second, three points behind. Jonny moved up to third on 47, and Josh slipped to fourth. Jack fell two places to seventh.
motw: Brahmes, 55 points, the best of the week. Cunha made 10 with an assist, 3 bonus and a defensive contribution of 14. Rogers added 9 and N.Jackson 9. Three of the week's best eleven were his, and he climbed to sixth. Still 62 points behind Ben, but moving in the right direction.
stinker: Jack, 29 points, the lowest of the week. Mbeumo's 8 was the only real return. Rayan took 2 points from Bournemouth's 5 goals conceded, and Petrović sat on the bench for 0 after the same 5. Jack dropped two places to seventh.
bench: Asher left 11 points on the bench, and the cause was Donnarumma. He made 9 for Man City with 6 saves, a clean sheet and a bonus point. Asher started Martinez, who made 3. The bench was the better goalkeeper. Asher is now second, three points behind Ben.
bench_jam: Jamie's Rúben came on for Castagne and made 6 for Man City, with a clean sheet and 4 defensive contribution points. Castagne had arrived on waivers this week, so the auto-sub earned its keep. Jamie remains eighth, but this was a good bit of luck.
red_card: Horníček of Newcastle, owned by Jamie. 90 minutes, 4 goals conceded against Coventry, 2 saves, 0 points. Jamie scored 32 this week and finished last in the league. The goalkeeper did not help.
gloves: Horníček again, gentlemen. Newcastle's keeper conceded 4 and made 2 saves, so Jamie takes the gloves as well. A double award for one player. Jamie sits eighth on 212.

xi.115: De Cuyper scored for Brighton and kept a clean sheet. 15 points in 67 minutes, the top score in the team. Asher owns him, and the Brighton clean sheet helped others too.
xi.8: Calafiori scored for Arsenal and made 9. Ben's. He had a good week at the top of the table.
xi.504: Vuskovic kept a clean sheet for Brighton and recorded 15 defensive contribution points. 8 for Ben. Ben had another Brighton player in Groß.
xi.236: Dewsbury-Hall scored and assisted for Everton, with 3 bonus. 13 points for Jonny, who moved up to third.
xi.428: Cunha made 10 for Man Utd with an assist and 3 bonus. Brahmes owns him. The 1-1 draw with Spurs did not hurt.
xi.399: Cherki scored for Man City and made 10. Jonny owns him, as the Liverpool defence found out.
xi.40: Rogers scored for Chelsea and made 9 in 83 minutes. Brahmes again. Chelsea's 5 goals were widely enjoyed.
xi.452: Bruno G. scored for Arsenal in 27 minutes and took 3 bonus. 9 points for Louie. Efficient work.
